HH75
Just listed – city living with style! 

Welcome to this modern and stylish apartment located on North Street in the vibrant Northern/Arena Quarter of the city in a popular areas of Leeds City Centre.

Check this out – You don’t want to miss it!
-Purpose-Built Apartments, attached to a Grade II Listed Iconic Building – blending heritage with modern design. -Right in the heart of the city – perfect for busy professionals and affluent students looking to enjoy all the best ----Leeds has to offer! Due to spacious nature of the apartments this is ideal for singles and couples.

What’s inside?
-Fully Furnished – Just bring your suitcase and move in!
-Airy, spacious, light-filled apartments with high ceilings and great city views
-Contemporary Kitchens – Cook up a storm with:
-Fridge/Freezer | Dishwasher | Hob & Oven | Extractor | Washer/Dryer | Microwave – all integrated appliances included!
-Modern Bathrooms with bidets – sleek, stylish, and a touch of luxury

Extras you’ll love:
-Lift access to all floors
-Secure coded entry
-CCTV throughout
-Concierge on-site
-Loads more photos & videos available – just ask!
-Pet-friendly (well-behaved companions welcome!)

Viewings?
We work around you – evening and weekend slots available!
Ready to see it? Book now and step into your new home! We also have virtual 360 tour available on request.
